WoWFA Forever 1.0.2-beta - Persian for WoW Forever (game build 1.60.1.71037).

New: 137 more NPC names in Persian - the quest givers and turn-in NPCs of the WoW Forever content (Riverglades, Zephras Isle and more).
New: the addon now quietly notes, in English, every quest and NPC name it meets that has no Persian yet. Type /wowfa harvest to see how many. Sending the file WTF/Account/(account)/SavedVariables/WoWFA.lua to the WoWFarsi team lets the next version translate them. Only English game text is saved, nothing about you. /wowfa harvest off turns it off.

The classic quests and NPCs were checked against the open classic database: they are complete. What is still English is the new WoW Forever content.

A wrong NPC name: target it and type /wowfa target.

Data from ForeverDB.net
